text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent on CRM updates.

**2. Notes weren't the real win.** Consistent call summaries made handoffs and manager coaching far easier.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Reps who asked consent upfront and explained the purpose got almost no pushback.

**4. Accuracy varied.** Product names and noisy job sites tripped it up. A quick rep review still mattered.

**5. Adoption followed leadership.** Teams whose managers used the summaries in 1:1s stuck with it.

The tool didn't change how we sell. It gave us cleaner data to sell better.

What would you want from a pilot like this?
